scientific_integrity: Formal-power-series proof for every precision and index; finite recurrence and generating-function checks are corroborative and do not establish novelty or independence.
scientific_limitations: The binary-weight condition is sufficient, not necessary; the polylogarithmic exponent is an upper bound and is not claimed optimal. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: A linear digit-weight cutoff for ordered power-of-two compositions
